entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return my VeloBand Pulse. My order number is VF88-9102.

Certainly. Let me just pull that up... Okay, I see your order from December 15th. To make sure I'm handling this correctly, can I ask what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

What does it matter? I don't want it! I've had a massive family emergency and this is the first chance I've had to call. I'm not playing twenty questions, I just want my money back. This is ridiculous!
I understand your frustration, and I'm very sorry to hear you've been dealing with an emergency. My goal is just to understand the situation so I can find the best solution for you.

The solution is a refund! My husband had to be rushed to the hospital! He needed emergency surgery! You think I was worried about returning your fitness band? Get me your manager, now. I am not dealing with this.

I am so sorry to hear that, that sounds incredibly stressful. There's no need for a manager, I'm sure I can resolve this for you. I know how things can get turned upside down; my brother is on military deployment and plans change in an instant. Let me just check the policy on your purchase date.
You better. I'm one click away from leaving a review about this on every website I can find.

I understand. Please hold one moment... Okay, I've confirmed it here. It looks like all VeloFit products come with a 90-day return window. Your purchase was 32 days ago, so you are well within that timeframe. I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you. My apologies for the delay.
Oh. Well... fine. Good. That's all you had to do in the first place.

You're right, and I apologize for the hassle. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email on file. Just package the item in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method in 3 to 5 business days.
That's everything. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and I sincerely hope things are getting better for you and your family.
